data.narrative:
Ocius Technology is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Robert Dane, with A$176M in contracted Program of Record funding as of March 2026. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies: 8 private-market Defense & Security firms at Series B stage plus 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $176M funding proxy, yielding $334M. Peer-median analysis examines 8 same-sector, same-stage comparables—including Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B)—producing a median valuation of $1.1B with a range of $300M to $3.0B.

These methods triangulate to a valuation range of $284M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $730M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around market positioning and revenue generation relative to the peer set. The stage-progression method, anchored to contractual funding, provides downside guidance; the peer median is substantially higher, suggesting either Ocius trades at a discount to comparables or carries elevated execution risk. Key uncertainties include revenue realization from the Program of Record contract and competitive positioning within a heterogeneous peer cohort.
